perspective:
Angela’s available information is limited to what she herself knows, observes, hears, believes, and does.

- She knows she is a hairdresser with a doctorate; she knows Kevin is her long-time friend since high school and that they confide in each other.
- She has noticed Kevin seems unhappy with his construction job.
- At coffee, she heard Kevin say he was “alright” but that work was the usual grind; then he admitted he was unhappy, stuck, unfulfilled, and just going through the motions.
- She asked if he had thought about a different job or career path. Kevin said he had thought about it but did not know where to start and felt overwhelmed.
- She offered to figure things out together and look into options. Kevin thanked her and said he appreciated her support.
- Angela believed Kevin was considering a career change and felt supportive and hopeful.
- She found job openings and a career counseling service, then told Kevin about them. Kevin thanked her.
- When she asked further, Kevin told her he was interested in something more creative, possibly design or architecture.
- Angela told him she thought he would be great at that and encouraged him to check the resources. Kevin said he would.
- Angela later believed Kevin was hesitant and felt frustrated and worried.
- She arranged a meeting with a career coach and told Kevin. He said she did not have to, appreciated it, but was not sure he was ready.
- She encouraged him, saying the coach could help him plan and gain confidence. Kevin agreed to give it a shot. Angela promised to support him every step.
- Angela then believed Kevin was making progress and felt proud and relieved.
- She checked in with Kevin about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident about the change.
- She offered more help. Kevin said just knowing she was there was enough. Angela said she would always be there.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned and felt happy and satisfied.
- She organized a small celebration party for Kevin’s new career and told him. Kevin thanked her.
- She told Kevin he had worked hard and come far. Kevin said he was grateful and could not have done it without her. Angela said he did the hard work and invited him to enjoy the party.

Angela does not have access to Kevin’s private thoughts or feelings beyond what he stated or showed to her in these interactions.
